channel.niche: pre-K / early-elementary learning (ages 2-7): counting, ABCs, phonics, shapes, colors, animals, feelings - taught by a cartoon dog
channel.name: Learn With Willow

video._note: KIDS DELTA vs base skill: slower delivery for ages 2-7, so ~75 words ~= ~33-38s. Keep 6 beats (one idea per beat). Still aim for the VO to be slightly shorter than 6x5s=30s of clips... for kids we actually use LONGER holds per image (see style.motion) so target ~6 clips at 6s. Re-check fps after edit_speed.

models._video_note: Do NOT use kling2_6 (failed a whole batch, still charged). For Willow TALKING shots, add a lipsync pass (Pika generate_lipsync) over the animated clip.
models._voice_note: KIDS DELTA: this channel uses MULTIPLE family voices, not one narrator. Clone each family member once via the ElevenLabs REST API (see channel/bible.md > Voice cast). Fill the ids below after cloning. tts.ps1 takes -VoiceId to pick which voice per line.

tts_voices.willow: <ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID - Willow the Wonder Pup (see bible: 5yo girl pitched bright, OR a dedicated playful clone)>

style.image_suffix: bright cheerful 2D cartoon storybook illustration for young children, bold clean outlines, flat saturated candy colors, soft rounded shapes, simple uncluttered background, big friendly eyes, wholesome and warm, preschool picture-book aesthetic, single clear subject centered, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no scary elements
style.motion: gentle bouncy idle motion, soft bobbing, slow friendly push-in, NO fast or jarring moves (calm for little kids)

captions._note: KIDS DELTA: big rounded friendly word captions at the BOTTOM (not aggressive hormozi middle). Toddlers/pre-readers + parents reading along. Keep 1-3 words per cue.

style.character_consistency: Willow MUST look identical every video. Pass her locked reference image(s) into every generate_image call as a character reference, and keep characters/willow-character-brief.md open. Regenerate the reference from the REAL dog photos once provided (see INTAKE.md).

audio.music_brief: happy gentle xylophone/ukulele/glockenspiel kids nursery melody, major key, simple and loopable, ~60s
audio.intro_sting: 1.5s Willow bark + sparkle -> show title card
audio.outro: Willow waves: 'Come learn with Willow!' + soft loop back to start

youtube._coppa_note: REQUIRED BY LAW: this is child-directed content -> selfDeclaredMadeForKids = true on every upload. Do NOT cheat this (FTC fines). It disables comments/memberships/Super Thanks/personalized ads. The money comes from elsewhere - see channel/MONETIZATION.md.

distribution._note: Produce the 9:16 master once, post everywhere. Re-cut 16:9 + 1:1 from the same assets.
